title: Rainbow Joes landing page implementation
summary: Implemented and verified a responsive landing page while leaving production deployment pending.
objective: Build a mobile landing page for Rainbow Joes and verify navigation.
outcome: The landing page and mobile menu were implemented and checked at desktop and mobile sizes.
